## BP Campaign Sender
**Source:** BP — Companies Sales DB (قاعدة الشركات)
**Send list:** Email not empty · Campaign Sent = false · Duplicate = false · **Suppressed = false**

### PAUSED as of 2026-08-06
The first campaign bounced at 25–40% (safe ceiling: 5%) and put the sending domain at risk. Publish this workflow again only after reading `docs/marketing-agent/email-campaign-hygiene.md`.

### Safety chain
1. `Get Ready-to-Send` pulls up to 60 candidates.
2. `Guard: Validate Before Send` drops suppressed / duplicate / malformed / dead-domain / global-platform / placeholder addresses and **caps the run at 25**.
3. `Build Emails` renders the template. `TEST_TO = ""` means LIVE — put your own address there to test.
4. `Mark Sent` writes the result back to Notion.

### Companion workflows
- **BP — Sales DB Hygiene** — run after every list import.
- **BP — Bounce Handler** — every 4h, marks bounced addresses Failed so they are never retried.

### Before raising the volume
Keep 25/day for at least two weeks. Only raise it once the rolling 7-day bounce rate is under 3%.

nodes.name: Campaign Schedule — 10:00 daily

parameters.notes: Once daily at 10:00 Asia/Riyadh. Each run pulls up to 60 candidates; the guard node caps actual sends at 25.

nodes.notes: Runs twice daily at 09:00 and 15:00. Each run pulls up to 50 Ready to Send leads.

nodes.name: Guard: Validate Before Send
nodes.notes: Last line of defence before Gmail. Drops anything the hygiene pass would suppress and caps the run at 25.

nodes.name: MX Lookup (dns.google)
nodes.notes: Live MX check per address. No credential needed — dns.google is a public DNS-over-HTTPS resolver.

nodes.name: Drop Domains Without MX
nodes.notes: Pairs each DNS answer back to its lead by position and drops the undeliverable ones.
